title: docs(create-objectstack): the blank starter stops advising a second app, which the app package refuses
body:
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBHsuuVaWZ1CxXQsjTfPVnWD)_ Fixes #32295 Clause-②: no Metadata-protocol: none ## 维护者速读 - 改了什么:blank 起步模板的 README、`src/apps/main.app.ts` 与 `src/apps/index.ts` 注释、入门文档页,以及 `os init` 生成的 `src/apps/index.ts` 头注释,都不再建议"再生成一个 app",改为"在现有 app 里加导航项(`group` 可嵌套),再用 `objectstack generate view OBJECT` 生成列表视图"。 - 为什么改:起步模板已自带一个 app,而 app 包最多只能有一个 app(ADR-0019 D3),照旧文案执行 `os g app` 会直接失败退出 1。 - 风险与回滚:只改文案和注释;`os init` 只是 apps barrel 头注释换了文字,其它 barrel 字节不变,无元数据行为变化;回滚即 revert 本 PR。 - 先看:`packages/cli/src/commands/init.ts`(`renderEmptyWiredBarrel` 的 app 分支)、`packages/create-objectstack/src/templates/blank/README.md`(第 55-60 行)、`content/docs/getting-started/your-first-project.mdx`(第 284-291 行)。 - 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter create-objectstack test`,预期 25 个文件 379 个测试全过。 - 需要你做的:无,席位落地。 ## What changes The blank starter ships one app (`src/apps/main.app.ts`, since #32209), and a package whose manifest type is `app` holds at most one app (ADR-0019 D3). Four texts told the author to generate a second app for a new object, and following them makes `os g app` exit 1. Each now says what `os init`'s starter app comment says (from #32291, `packages/cli/src/commands/init.ts`): add a navigation entry to the starter app (a `group` entry with children nests them) rather than a second app, and give the object a list view with `objectstack generate view OBJECT`. - `content/docs/getting-started/your-first-project.mdx`: the "starter ships one app" callout drops `npx os generate app NAME --object OBJECT` and the "or generate an app of its own" aside; it keeps `npx os generate view OBJECT`. - `packages/create-objectstack/src/templates/blank/README.md`: the Console section drops "or add an app of its own under `src/apps/`" and the `generate app` command; it keeps `objectstack generate view OBJECT`. - `packages/create-objectstack/src/templates/blank/src/apps/main.app.ts`: the header comment takes `os init`'s wording. The `Written by objectstack generate app main --object note` provenance line stays: it records how the file was made and is not advice for adding navigation. - `.changeset/32295-blank-starter-one-app-advice.md`: `create-objectstack: patch`, since the template ships in that package. `content/docs` is not a published package, so it needs no changeset of its own. - `packages/cli/src/commands/init.ts` + `packages/create-objectstack/src/templates/blank/src/apps/index.ts` (seat 4 amendment on #32295, comment 6775709558, after round 1 stopped on this file): the blank apps barrel's line 1 is the empty wired barrel `os init` renders, byte-pinned by `create-objectstack-wiring-parity.test.ts`. `renderEmptyWiredBarrel` now gives the `app` barrel its own header: a package whose manifest type is `app` holds at most one app, `objectstack generate app NAME` writes it while there is none, and after that another object goes in as a navigation entry on that app (a `group` entry with children nests them) rather than a second app, or that app is replaced. Every other barrel header (views, actions, flows, objects and the rest) is byte-identical. The blank barrel takes the new bytes, so the parity test holds unchanged; no test pinned the old apps header, so no test file was edited. ## Tests Step 0, the failure on a copy of the blank template at `60b99f8f` (cli built from this tree, the copy's `node_modules` linked to `packages/cli/node_modules`):
os g app extra --object blank_note exits 1 with the ADR-0019 D3 message ```text $ node packages/cli/bin/run.js g app extra --object blank_note Type: app — Application navigation Name: extra Object: blank_note (--object) File: src/apps/extra.app.ts ✗ Refusing to generate — with src/apps/extra.app.ts in place, objectstack.config.ts no longer loads defineStack single-app validation failed (1 issue): ✗ An 'app' package must define at most one app, but found 2 (blank_extra_app, blank_main_app). Fold them into one app with multiple tabs, or split into separate packages — ADR-0019 (app-as-consumer-unit) D3. The scaffold and its barrel line were removed again, so nothing was written. exit 1 ```
Every command the new texts leave, run on a fresh copy of the edited template. The `group` entry was added by hand to `main.app.ts`, as the texts say:
new object, a group navigation entry, os generate view, os validate: all exit 0 ```text $ os g object task → ✓ Created src/objects/task.object.ts exit 0 (main.app.ts: added { id: 'work_group', type: 'group', label: 'Work', children: [{ id: `${Task.name}_nav`, type: 'object', label: 'Tasks', objectName: Task.name }] }) $ os generate view blank_task → ✓ Created src/views/blank_task.view.ts exit 0 $ os validate → ✓ Validation passed · UI: 1 Apps 2 Views exit 0 ```
Suites at 16dba99e ```text pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli build && pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck exit 0 pnpm --filter create-objectstack test Test Files 25 passed (25) Tests 379 passed (379) pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 test/create-objectstack-wiring-parity.test.ts test/init-template-comments-self-contained.test.ts test/print-metadata-stats-zero-row.test.ts test/scaffold-workspace-consistency.test.ts test/scaffold-ci-script-parity.test.ts test/docs-cli-enumeration-parity.test.ts test/init.test.ts test/starter-field-consumers.test.ts test/scaffold-object-declaration-shape.test.ts Test Files 9 passed (9) Tests 209 passed (209) pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit --maxWorkers=2 Test Files 412 passed (412) Tests 5887 passed (5887) ``` The cli integration tier is declared to CI (the diff touches no spawn entry or integration file).
No ablation: the diff changes prose and comment text only (the cli change is the text of one rendered comment), not tested behaviour. ## Acceptance notes - The new apps header is true in every `os init` template: checked live, `os init -t app` writes it above its `main` export line and matches the blank barrel byte for byte; `os init -t plugin` writes it as an empty barrel, and there `os g app extra --object p_plugin_item` exits 0 (a plugin package has no app yet); `-t empty` writes no `src/apps`. - `starter-field-consumers.e2e.test.ts` and `scaffold-emission-policy.e2e.test.ts` (nightly tier) also read the template; they read objects and fields, which this diff does not touch. Not run locally. ## Verification Derived gate families at `16dba99e` (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`, 7 paths vs merge base `60b99f8f`), run after a full `turbo run build` (120/120) and a fetch of the teardown fixture commit, so the three that round 1 could not measure ran this time: ```text dispatch-gates --ran: 93 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 93 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 93 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3). ```
